subtitle: Chat with your own AI agents
promotionalText: Talk to the agents on your own substrate: streaming replies, voice input transcribed on your device.
description:
Substrate Chat is a native chat for the agents on your substrate, the personal server you run or choose. Your conversations stay on that server.

• Streaming replies, instant from a warm cache
• Voice input, transcribed on your device
• Notifications when an agent answers
• An Action Button shortcut to start a chat
• On iPhone, iPad and Mac

The agents run on your substrate, with the AI model provider whoever runs it has chosen. Substrate Chat is a client for a substrate: sign in with your server's address and approve what the app may do there.
